Celeste's Flowers

Hey, I'm Maylin!

I'm 19, Honduran, and a proud daughter of immigrants. I originally started out making bouquets for my favorite people, and I've been sharing my floral journey online since last June. I really didn't want to be just another basic florist, so I started mixing my love for anime, video games, and my absolute favorite Pokémon, Psyduck, into my arrangements. Come hang out and watch me grow!

Adding a little Psyduck magic to every petal, gotta arrange 'em all!

Where We Deliver

Delivery & Shipping

  • Local delivery is available around Austin and surrounding Texas areas.
  • Eternal (artificial) flowers can be shipped outside the local area.
  • Fresh, natural flowers are not shipped — local delivery or pickup only.
  • Alcohol gifts are never shipped — local pickup or delivery only, and subject to age verification.

Good to Know

Frequently Asked Questions

Ordering & Timing

How much notice do you need for a custom order?

Standard custom arrangements need at least 24–48 hours notice, so I have time to source specific colors or flower varieties from local wholesalers.

What about weddings or large events?

Large events and weddings need a minimum of 2–4 weeks notice for bulk orders, custom color palettes, and venue coordination.

Delivery & Shipping

Can you ship fresh flowers to another state?

No — fresh flowers only travel well locally, so those are delivery or pickup only in the Austin area. Eternal flower arrangements can ship anywhere.

Do you require a deposit?

Yes, a nonrefundable deposit is required to begin custom orders — I'll go over exact details once we've talked through your vision.

¿Hablan español?

¡Sí! Puedes escribirme en español en cualquier momento, por mensaje o en el formulario de pedido.

Gifting & Add-Ons

Are gift baskets only for girlfriends or wives?

Not at all! Plenty of my baskets are built for guys too — sports themes, gaming and trading cards, favorite snacks, cologne, and characters they love. Flowers and baskets are for anyone you want to celebrate.

What add-ons can I include?

Popular add-ons include plushies, balloons, chocolates & candy, a custom card, LED lights, a favorite drink or snack, and vase upgrades — just mention it in your custom order.
